title: Action project file
description: Settings for checking Action sources in the editor. Paths are relative to this file.

includeDirs.description: Directories searched by 'import', like the compiler's -I. The workspace root and its lib directory are always searched.

defines.description: Constants defined as with the compiler's -D NAME=VALUE.

programs.description: Groups of files compiled together (as on the compiler's command line). A file listed here is checked with the rest of its group; any other file is checked on its own, with its imports.
